cooldown.binNote: Wiki quote reads 14 to 12 but the bin's cooldown array is [16/15/14/13/12]; recording the wiki's stated leveling values here per the wiki template while noting the bin disagrees by 2s at ranks 1-2.

values.binNote: Stun duration (0.25s) is stated only in the description text via {{fd|0.25}}; not a separate rank-based bin row.

mechanics.claim: The glaive extends and deals damage to enemies hit along the way (initial), then a second physical damage instance occurs upon reaching maximum range along with stun and pull.
mechanics.quote: extends his glaive in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. Upon reaching maximum range, all enemies hit are dealt {{as|physical damage}}, {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.25}} seconds, and {{tip|airborne|pulled}} 225 units toward '''Zaahen'''.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield blocks both damage instances, and can block the second pass individually.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block both passes, as well as the second one individually if circumstances permit.

mechanics.claim: Intercepting the initial projectile instantly triggers the pull (and presumably the secondary effects) at that point.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|projectile|Intercepting}} the initial projectile will instantly trigger ''Dreaded Return's'' pull.

mechanics.claim: If Zaahen is dead by the time the missile reaches maximum range, the max-range damage, stun, and pull do not occur.
mechanics.quote: The damage, stun, and pull from hitting the target do not occur if '''Zaahen''' is {{tip|death|dead}} by the time the missile reaches maximum range.
